title: July 31st! Ending The Month Just Right!

initial_import_attempt.reason: ffmpeg fps=1/3600 produced no frame for this 19m46s video; source download and original captions succeeded.
initial_import_attempt.recovery: remuxed original video locally, extracted audio, ran cached local ASR and semantic-frame selection.

manual_visual_review.method: All 21 semantic frames reviewed via contact sheet; first selected frame checked full resolution.

findings.manual_observation: Screenshot includes a YouTube replay interface layered over the trading stream, duplicated overlay text, channel promotions, chat and a chart. Visual content is compressed and nested in UI.
findings.limitation: Do not use tiny chart labels, values, or screenshot overlay captions as ground truth; no independently verified trading rule identified from this frame.

findings.manual_observation: Many screenshots repeat the same chart layout/period; several frames include handwritten drawing overlays and promotional/player UI. Later frames show a different panel view.
findings.limitation: Frames are not independent examples. Vision output remains raw until checked against video context.

usefulness_evidence.manual_visual_verification: Identified nested YouTube/player UI and repeated chart views; limits risk of attributing on-screen promo/player text to strategy.
usefulness_evidence.limits: No closed-book recall, market outcome validation or backtest run; useful as searchable/traversable source material only. Accepted candidates remain unverified.
